task: Add a CodeMie-owned analytics opt-out gate (preferences file + proxy analytics disable/enable/exclude/include/status CLI) in front of the claude-code-otlp hook pipeline's isTracked() check.

component_scope.label: L
component_scope.affected: claude-code-otlp.preferences (new preferences-file module), claude-code-otlp.gate (new gate combining preferences + existing allowlist), claude-code-otlp.plugin (isTracked wiring), proxy analytics-command (new CLI: disable/enable/exclude/include), proxy analytics-status (new CLI: status --json + hasClaudeCodeOtlpHooks), proxy connectors/claude-code-otlp (hook-presence helper), proxy index (command registration)

requirements_clarity.label: S
requirements_clarity.gaps: One review-time decision point: AC4 native-launch coverage gap, resolved by the user as 'document as manual/out-of-scope' rather than adding code; no rework required

technical_risk.label: L
technical_risk.risk_factors: New preferences-file abstraction introduced as a privacy/compliance-adjacent opt-out gate ahead of the existing OTLP tracking decision; fail-closed behavior required for corrupt/unreadable preferences; path-exclusion matching for nested project directories
technical_risk.mitigation: Reused the established atomic-write pattern (temp file + rename) already used elsewhere in the codebase; fail-closed (not tracked) on any corrupt/unreadable preferences file rather than failing open; dedicated AC4 regression matrix test added; no changes to OtlpAgentAdapter, the daemon, or the spool, keeping blast radius limited to the single isTracked() choke point

file_change_estimate.label: XXL
modified_file_list: docs (usage/architecture notes updated for the analytics gate; exact path not independently re-verified against the diff)

key_reasoning.reason: 16 files changed per diffstat (9 new, 7 modified) spanning two directory trees (claude-code-otlp plugin + proxy CLI commands plus their __tests__ subdirs and docs) — maps to the 16+ files XXL band per the actual-mode file-count mapping.

Seven distinct components touched across two layers: two brand-new abstractions (preferences file module, gate module) plus wiring into the existing plugin's isTracked(), two new CLI subcommand files, a new hook-presence helper, and CLI command registration — cross-cutting within the claude-code-otlp subsystem and the proxy CLI tree.

New preferences-file abstraction with no exact prior precedent in this plugin (closest precedent is the existing allowlist file and the atomic-write pattern used in config/migrations elsewhere), fail-closed design required on corruption. Red flag applied: analytics disable is a privacy/compliance-adjacent opt-out feature (user control over data collection) — bumped from M (3) to L (4).

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped from M (3) to L (4): analytics disable/opt-out is a privacy/compliance-adjacent requirement (user control over data collection), matching the Security/Compliance red flag.
